As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. leads.snippet: paddy is building the agentic operating system for teaching and learning. Born out of our own experience in schools, our team is developing an AI platform deeply embedded in day-to-day teaching, from lesson preparation and delivery to analysis. Today, thousands of teachers and tens of thousands of students use paddy every day. Our mission: to meaningfully reduce teachers’ workload while improving teaching quality, so students are better prepared for the future.
